question: What result is claimed when the practice has been carried out for one year, namely the destruction of old age and death?
premises: A duration of one year is specified for the practice.
A condition is stated of that practice having been done.
Under that condition, old age and death are destroyed.
inference: Practice sustained for one year results in the destruction of old age and death.
uncertainties: The exact practice referred to is not named in this verse.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
